beforeWholeSelectedDecision.rationale: AUTHOR-only current source8 successor. Actual SN physical24/printed12: e5 covers only the introductory significance/use/handling competence as a PARTIAL contribution. The separate indented LEFT-column experimental investigation of acidic solutions with indicators is a real curricular part and remains required/unresolved by e5. The right column contains SE beside that experiment and contextual classification/acid-rain remarks beside the introduction. No experiment is deleted, optionalized, performed or certified by this material-based introduction. All five existing partner bindings remain partial, without a new approval of their full operators or of the whole composite source row. Existing source-cell component limits remain; no full-source/course or D/P/A/M/V approval is asserted.

afterWholeSelectedDecision.sourceSpan: Klassenstufe 8, Säuren und deren saure Lösungen, PDF-S. 24
afterWholeSelectedDecision.rationale: AUTHOR-only separate SN indicator addendum after frozen source8 v2. The real indented LEFT-column experimental investigation of acidic solutions with indicators on physical PDF page 24 / printed page 12 remains curricular; the right-column SE does not turn it into an optional remark. Existing D2cc contributes indicator-specific observation, solution classification and coarse pH-range interpretation in suitable school experiments. Its unchanged full positive-evidence profile contains two fresh safely supplied observation/scale cases; these do not certify that the learner performed an experiment. This is a PARTIAL source binding for that experimental component, not complete execution evidence or whole-row/source-union clearance. E5 continues to cover only the introductory significance/use/handling component. All five older partial partner bindings are preserved exactly, without a new judgment of their full operators. No ordinary semantics, P body, image, memory, target set, stored selection or human approval changes.
